name: 'X yapmam lazim' adds a task; 'X'i kaldir' removes the task when no event matches
incident: ADR 0013: tasks are added by 'gorev ekle X' or 'X yapmam lazim', completed by 'X bitti/yaptim', removed by 'X'i kaldir' (explicit 'gorev' always means the task list). Removing a task changes only Sebastian's own list.
